title: 第21章 李家关系图谱
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
宋锦大学是学工商管理专业的。

    或许是家里做工程的缘故，计算精细，耳濡目染下，她对数字很是敏感。

    不到十秒钟。

    她就计算出来，李西海290W资金，连吃十二个涨停板的收益。

    910W！

    这个数字，让宋锦呼吸都不由急促。

    家里几千万资产，也拿不出近千万的现金流出来。

    不管是什么时代，现金为王是永恒不变的。

    资产都是虚的，随时都可能打折缩水，现金才是实打实的硬实力。

    “他运道怎么会这么好。”

    “是撞上的，还是运气使然？”

    宋锦呢喃自语。

    李西海那从容不迫，自信淡然的神色与语气。

    不像是撞上。

    普通的散户股民，吃几个涨停就已经拿不住了。

    李西海却是硬生生拿了十二连板，都不谈一句要获利离场的。

    要么是有绝对的信心，要么就是绝对的贪婪。

    但不管自信，还是贪婪。

    计算出来的数字不会错，李西海是一个有千万身家的男人。

    “万一他是骗人的呢？”

    “可有必要吗？”

    宋锦的脑海很乱，想了一会儿不想了。

    走出房间下楼，父亲宋建兴正喝着早茶。

    “锦锦起来了啊。”

    宋建兴举起茶杯，笑道：“喝茶吗？”

    “不喝。”

    宋锦摇了摇头，准备去磨咖啡喝。

    她是不太喜欢喝茶的，总觉得喝茶是中年男人的标配。

    也不知道为什么，男人一到年纪后，就特别喜欢喝茶。

    咖啡才是她们这种小年轻特有的调调。

    “最近你这几天早出晚归的，干什么去了？”
content_en:
Songjin University majors in business administration.

    Perhaps it was because of the engineering work she did at home and her careful calculations, which made her very sensitive to numbers.

    Less than ten seconds.

    She calculated that Li Xihai’s capital was 2.9 million, and he had earned twelve consecutive daily limit profits.

    910W!

    This number made Song Jin's breathing quicken.

    The family has tens of millions of assets, but they can't come up with nearly tens of millions of cash flow.

    No matter what era it is, cash is king forever.

    Assets are all fictitious and may be discounted or shrunk at any time. Cash is the real hard power.

    "How could he be so lucky?"

    "Did it happen by chance, or was it luck?"

    Song Jin murmured to himself.

    Li Xihai's calm, confident and indifferent look and tone.

    It's not like a collision.

    Ordinary retail investors can no longer hold on after a few daily limits.

    Li Xihai, on the other hand, took twelve consecutive boards without saying a word about leaving the game with a profit.

    Either there is absolute confidence, or there is absolute greed.

    But regardless of confidence, it is still greed.

    The calculated figures are correct. Li Xihai is a man with a net worth of tens of millions.

    "What if he is a liar?"

    "Is it necessary?"

    Song Jin's mind was very confused and he thought about it for a while.

    After walking out of the room and going downstairs, his father Song Jianxing was drinking morning tea.

    "Jinjin is up."

    Song Jianxing raised his teacup and said with a smile, "Would you like some tea?"

    "Don't drink."

    Song Jin shook his head and prepared to grind coffee to drink.

    She doesn't really like drinking tea. She always feels that drinking tea is a standard for middle-aged men.

    I don’t know why, but men especially like to drink tea when they get older.

    Coffee is the unique flavor of young people like them.

    "You go out early and come back late these days. What have you been doing?"
title_en: Chapter 21 The Relationship Map of the Li Family
